settings.label: Business coach for owners of small companies
settings.heading: Grow the business without working every evening
settings.text: I help owners of companies with two to twenty people get their numbers, their team and their week in order, so the business runs on more than you.
settings.image_alt: Mateo Cruz, arms crossed, in front of a whiteboard

settings.heading: If this is your week, we should talk
settings.text: Most owners I work with are good at what they sell. The business around it grew faster than the way they run it.

settings.title: Every question still ends up on your desk
settings.text: The team waits for you, so you answer messages until late.

settings.title: Busy months, and still no idea what is left
settings.text: Sales are up, but you find out about cash at the end of the quarter.

settings.title: You hired, and it got harder
settings.text: New people, no clear jobs, and you redo half the work.

settings.title: Prices you set three years ago
settings.text: Costs went up. Your prices did not, because asking feels risky.

settings.title: A plan in your head, nowhere else
settings.text: You know where you want to be next year. Nobody else does.

settings.title: No day off that stays a day off
settings.text: Holidays are spent on the phone, so you stopped taking them.

settings.heading: Three ways to work together
settings.text: Every client starts with the same free call. Then we pick the one that fits where the business is now, and you can move between them.
settings.note: Want me to run a workshop for your team? Ask about dates

settings.label: One to one
settings.title: Monthly coaching
settings.text: Two calls a month and messages in between, for owners who want someone in their corner.
settings.points:
Two 60 minute calls a month
Messages answered within a working day
A one page plan we update each month
Stop or pause any month

settings.image_alt: Mateo speaking to a room of business owners
settings.label: Small group
settings.title: The Growth Sprint
settings.text: Eight owners, eight weeks, one topic a week: numbers, prices, hiring, delegation, sales and the plan.
settings.points:
Eight live sessions on video
A workbook for each week
Two one to one calls with me
A group of owners to stay in touch with

settings.label: In person or online
settings.title: Strategy day
settings.text: One full day on the whiteboard with you and up to three of your team. We leave with a plan for the year.
settings.points:
A call before the day to prepare
Six hours together, lunch included
The plan written up within a week
A follow up call after 30 days

settings.heading: From the first call to a plan you use
settings.text: No long questionnaire and no theory. We work on your real numbers and your real calendar from week one.
settings.image_alt: Mateo at a whiteboard, explaining with both hands

settings.title: A free call
settings.text: You tell me where the business is stuck. I tell you honestly whether I can help, and how.

settings.title: Look at the numbers
settings.text: Sales, margins, cash and where your hours go. One page that shows what is really happening.

settings.title: Pick three changes
settings.text: Not twenty. Three changes with the most effect, each with an owner and a date.

settings.title: Do the work, check in
settings.text: We meet, look at what moved and what did not, and adjust. You keep the plan between calls.

settings.image_alt: Mateo Cruz smiling at a meeting table
settings.heading: I ran a small company before I coached them
settings.text:
For eleven years I ran a print and signage business that grew from two people to sixteen. I made most of the mistakes my clients make now, usually twice.

Since selling it, I have worked with owners of bakeries, agencies, cleaning companies and workshops. The problems are almost always the same: prices, cash, hiring and an owner doing too much.
settings.fact_3: Sessions: On video or in person

settings.image_alt: Mateo giving a talk to a room of business owners
settings.heading: Bring it to your team or your event
settings.text: Half day and full day workshops on pricing, cash and delegation, for teams, business groups and conferences.

settings.heading: Before you book
settings.text: Anything else? Send me a message and I will answer within a working day.

settings.question: Who do you work with?
settings.answer: Owners of companies with roughly two to twenty people: shops, studios, agencies, trades and services. If you are just starting out, the Growth Sprint is a good first step.

settings.question: What happens on the free call?
settings.answer: Twenty minutes on video. You tell me where the business is stuck, I ask a few questions, and I say honestly whether I can help. There is no pitch at the end.

settings.question: How long do clients usually stay?
settings.answer: Most stay four to six months on monthly coaching. You can stop or pause any month, with no notice period.

settings.question: Do you work in person?
settings.answer: Monthly coaching and the Growth Sprint are on video. Strategy days can be in person in Austin, at your place for a travel fee, or online.

settings.question: Can my business pay for it?
settings.answer: Yes. You get an invoice in the company's name for every payment.

settings.question: What if it is not working?
settings.answer: Tell me. If after the first month you feel it is not worth it, I refund that month.

settings.heading: Let's look at your week
settings.text: Twenty minutes on video. You say where the business is stuck; I say whether I can help.
settings.note: No pitch. If we are not a fit, I will say so.
settings.name: Mateo Cruz
settings.points:
Where the business is now
What is taking your time
One next step, either way
